news.headline: Situational Awareness trims Nebius stake to about 3.4% from 5.6%
news.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund, whose 5.6% stake disclosure in May lifted the stock, now holds about 3.4% of Nebius according to a new report. The cut comes as the stock trades well below its pre-earnings level after the Q3 capacity delays and capex increase.

news.headline: Nebius Group (NBIS) director sells 4,502 shares under a trading plan.
news.summary: A Nebius director sold 4,502 shares under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, so the sale was scheduled in advance rather than a fresh signal. It came days after the post-earnings sell-off.

news.headline: D.A. Davidson Just Cut Its Nebius Target From $250 to $125
news.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria kept a Neutral rating and halved his target to $125, citing data-center delays and weaker run-rate guidance. Rosenblatt reiterated Buy with a $304 target the same day.

news.headline: Nebius beats Q3 revenue estimates, shares fall as data center delays weigh on 2026 outlook
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 571% to $980.8M (est. ~$907M) and adjusted EBITDA reached $465.8M, both above consensus. ARR ended September at $6.4B; Nebius now expects to pass $7B in February rather than December and will drop ARR targets from 2027 in favor of revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity.

news.headline: Nebius shares tumble 22% as capacity delays hit revenue outlook and capex rises to $27 billion
news.summary: Nebius steered 2026 revenue toward the low end of its $3.0-3.4B range after its colocation partner DataOne reset a site's power schedule. It raised 2026 capex to about $27B and guided 2027 capex to $40-45B; analysts also flagged roughly $325M of non-recurring Q3 revenue.

news.headline: Microsoft tightens oversight of Nebius, IREN and Nscale data center deals (Bloomberg)
news.summary: Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is scrutinizing some neocloud data-center projects more closely and leaning more on its own capacity, with a Nebius New Jersey site cited for a generator-permit fine. NBIS fell up to ~20% intraday; Microsoft called the checks routine.

news.headline: Nebius signs on for 50MW at NEOM's Oxagon data center in Saudi Arabia
news.summary: HUMAIN and DataVolt signed a preliminary framework making Nebius the anchor customer for up to 50MW, half of the first 100MW phase at the Oxagon AI campus. Capacity is expected to come online in phases from Q4 2027, and the terms are not yet binding.

catalysts.label: ARR to pass $7B
catalysts.detail: Management now expects annualized run-rate revenue to exceed $7B in February 2027, slipping from the original year-end 2026 target of $7-9B after data-center power delays.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results and first 2027 targets
catalysts.detail: Expected around February (date not announced). This is the first report under the new framework of revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity targets instead of ARR; watch delivery against the low end of the $3.0-3.4B FY26 range and the $40-45B 2027 capex plan.

catalysts.label: Meta dedicated capacity ramp
catalysts.detail: The expanded Meta contract (base ~$12B, up to ~$27B) starts delivering dedicated AI compute across multiple sites in early 2027.

catalysts.label: Lappeenranta (Finland) 310MW AI factory first capacity
catalysts.detail: First capacity at the ~$10B multi-building campus is expected to reach customers in 2027.

catalysts.label: NEOM Oxagon capacity (up to 50MW)
catalysts.detail: Phased go-live from Q4 2027 under a preliminary HUMAIN/DataVolt framework; a binding offtake agreement is still pending.

pulse: Nebius delivered a big Q3 beat on Nov 12 (revenue $981M, +571%; adj. EBITDA $466M), but power delays at a colocation partner pushed the $7B ARR milestone to February. It also steered 2026 revenue to the low end of guidance and raised capex to ~$27B (2027: $40-45B). The stock had already fallen ~30% from late October on Bloomberg's report about Microsoft's neocloud oversight and dropped again after earnings to around $117-129. The bull case still rests on the Microsoft and Meta contracts converting on schedule, while capex intensity and execution timing are the open questions.
